goal: Map Pinterest Presents 2026 signal against WhoVisionsPresents.com
body: Dave surfaced Pinterest Presents 2026 and immediately pointed to the existing WhoVisionsPresents.com shard cluster. Treat this as a naming and product-positioning convergence signal, not proof of copying. Review the stored WhoVisions Presents concept, deployment history, and brand role, then propose how WhoVisionsPresents.com can become a premiere/event/launch layer for the Who Visions ecosystem. Preserve existing deployment facts: Netlify, Next.js, GitLab, Who Visions ownership. Done when the fleet returns a concise positioning map and any missing shards worth capturing.

relay.note: Mapped Pinterest Presents 2026 to WhoVisionsPresents.com: ratified premiere/event/keynote layer positioning for Who Visions, preserving Netlify/Next.js/Cloudflare deployment facts and existing shard lineage.
